svg.title: Retained shell indexing and coordinate seam
svg.desc: The saved mesh has two near-coincident 441-vertex skins and a 160-vertex edge band. Their 320 indexed boundary edges are highlighted in red in an exploded display. Welding coincident coordinates yields 882 vertices, one connected watertight component and zero boundary edges without changing the shell shape.
svg.text: Retained mesh, open at the seams.
SAVED MESH 06 / SOURCE GEOMETRY · NOT A STRESS RESULT
LEFT: COMPONENTS OFFSET FOR DISPLAY ONLY · RIGHT: WELDED INDEXING, IDENTICAL BOUNDS AND AREA
